title: "Coolest thing any streamer does": Jynxzi steps outside gaming to support Maya Higa’s wildlife mission with $100,000 donation
summary_full: Renowned streamer Jynxzi has generously contributed $100,000 to Alveus Sanctuary, a nonprofit aimed at wildlife conservation led by Maya Higa. This remarkable donation will aid in providing homes for various animals and enhancing educational outreach about wildlife. Jynxzi expressed deep respect for Higa's commitment to conservation, demonstrating a powerful impact that online influencers can make on animal welfare initiatives.
